description: This file defines the XFont class, a core class in the PDFsharp library for representing and manipulating font objects in PDF documents. It includes constructors for various font sources (system fonts, WPF, GDI, etc.), properties for font metrics and styles, and internal initialization methods to set up font descriptors and metrics. The class facilitates font rendering and PDF text drawing, with support for different platforms and font configurations.

classes.name: XFont
classes.description: Represents a font used for drawing text in a PDF document, supporting various font sources and styles, with methods for accessing font metrics and rendering details.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the font by resolving typefaces, creating descriptors, and initializing font metrics, depending on platform-specific font sources.

methods.name: InitializeFromGdi
methods.description: Initializes font properties from a GDI+ font object.

methods.name: InitializeFromWpf
methods.description: Initializes font properties from a WPF font object.

methods.name: CreateDescriptorAndInitializeFontMetrics
methods.description: Creates font descriptors and initializes font metrics based on the font's OpenType data.

methods.name: GetHeight
methods.description: Returns the line height of the font in pixels based on font metrics.
